definitions.explanation: The night of two days ago — the evening preceding last night.

examples.japanese: {一昨夜|いっさくや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れなかった→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't sleep the night before last.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一昨夜|いっさくや}⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: The incident happened the night before last.

examples.japanese: {一昨夜|いっさくや}⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰宅|きたく}した→帰宅する：22169_kitakusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: I got home late the night before last, so I'm still tired.

notes:
A somewhat formal word, common in writing and news. In casual speech, ⟦おととい→おととい：00877_ototoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧ is more usual.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{昨夜|さくや}→昨夜：02999_sakuya⟧: last night
- {一昨日|おととい}: the day before yesterday
- {一昨夜|いっさくや}: the night of the day before yesterday
